description: Base mainnet transaction lookup by hash: status (success, failed, or pending), block, timestamp, confirmations, from, to, ETH value, total fee including the L1 data fee, method id, and every USDC transfer in the transaction decoded to sender, recipient, and amount. Useful for confirming that a USDC or x402 payment really settled before delivering goods. Read-only. Not charged for an invalid hash, a hash not found on Base, or when Base can't be reached. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
name: chain_tx
title: Base transaction status: success/failed/pending, fee, confirmations, USDC transfers
